name: Kamimori Akio
source:
The protagonist.

A new teacher at the private Seirei Academy.

He's friendly and has good taste, so he's well-liked by the students, but he has an extraordinary sexual desire that he can't control, and is troubled by an ever-increasing desire to "rape women."

[Translated from the [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc032/character/akio.html]official site[/url]]
